purpose: Source-and-evidence inventory of all 68 current starter definitions. Links are audit pointers, not automatic full-card certification. No card or deck is admitted by this inventory. The broader catalog and original product requirements remain in scope.
sharedRequiredWork: Complete per-draw costs, broader card-granted draw-X/choose-Y and weapon adapters, optional/delayed battle conversion, broader substitution providers and physical draw limits, automatic modifiers and individual Force-use timing. Gambler’s Luck and combined battle totals have partial supplemental component coverage.

Extend action-specific source/target identity semantics to remaining effects/events, retrieval/search/inspection, group movement and duels; preserve initiated actions and handle persona/conversion aliases.
Generic continuous modifier, prevention/replacement, persona/uniqueness and characteristic infrastructure.
Resolve explicit failed-duel and deeper Chances-chain guards before admitting any deck able to reach them.
Full randomized starter match conformance, including cross-card event timing and replay/recovery, not only component fixtures.
Durable full-match API/CAS/receipts, trusted deadlines, authenticated seats, CPU/PvP and responsive gameplay.
Broader catalog, vehicles/pilots/passengers, Objectives/special setup, open 40/60 and sealed/deck customization requirements.

zoneInstances.scope: Private serialized zone visits; pending Stun, Barrier, ground movement, attachment deployment/transfer and Old Ben Lost target references; instance-scoped movement, battle history, bearer weapon/device allowances and table modifiers. Component-only, not universal target coverage.

initiatedFiring.scope: Initiated weapon firing survives source/bearer departure; new card instance can join before power, never afterward. Comlink react initiation remains valid after source departure. 27 matching controlled GEMP observations; not full card admission.

beforeDestiny.scope: Shared pre-reveal response boundary for all currently implemented physical destiny draws, including battle, weapons and Dice redraws. Empty Reserve excludes about-to-draw text; live top-card and weapon location modifier evaluation. Eight matching GEMP event traces. Per-draw costs/substitution/choose-X and broader card effects remain; no full admission.

substitutedDestiny.scope: Shared substituted value with no physical draw; locked individual value, separate modifiable total, battle/weapon/serial continuations and Dice exclusion. Smoke Screen 5_69 uses current ground character ability; four matching GEMP outcomes. Supplemental component, no production admission.

destinySelection.scope: Generic draw X then choose Y; retained unresolved values, serialized selection, canceled draw cleanup/redraw, original-instance cleanup, selected total, optional unchosen-to-hand.
